rows.question: How do users reset a forgotten password?
rows.answer: Users reset forgotten passwords from Sign-in > Forgot password Admins can send a reset link from Identity > Users Reset links expire after 15 minutes and require MFA

rows.question: What analytics export options are available?
rows.answer: Reports may be saved as CSV or PDF Scheduled exports can email recipients daily or weekly Large report files are prepared asynchronously in the export center

rows.question: How should operators triage an incident?
rows.answer: Operators can view dashboards and audit logs Administrators can invite users, update roles, and revoke access tokens Incident dashboard access is read-only

rows.answer: Failed API calls return structured JSON errors with code, message, and request id Clients should log the request id before contacting support

rows.question: When is removed account information deleted?
rows.answer: Account owners can remove team members from workspace access Removed users lose access immediately but their audit events remain visible

rows.answer: Search result cache entries expire after 10 minutes The service uses stale-while-revalidate for popular queries so users can receive a fast cached response while refresh runs
